verdict.rationale: Kick documents core close building blocks — reconciliation against bank/card statements, period locking that finalizes books once an accountant reviews them, rules to standardize categorization, and a full audit trail of activity — which together cover much of a month-end close workflow. However, there is no documented unified 'checklist' feature that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and sign-offs as a single trackable list, nor explicit mention of accrual entry workflows tied to close. Missing for 10: an explicit close-checklist UI/tool, documented accrual scheduling/tracking, and evidence tying reconciliation+locks+accruals into one sign-off tracked list.
